name: Freighter signed challenge creates a secure session
description: Protects the existing wallet login flow and ensures the backend only creates sessions after a valid signature.
steps: Connect Freighter on Testnet
Approve the public address request
Sign the AidTrace challenge
Open My Activity and then sign out
expected: A verified wallet session is created without a transaction; signing out clears the session cookie and no seed phrase is requested.

name: On-chain verification distinguishes matching and mismatching payments
covers: Verified on-chain status only on full match
description: Checks that a record is only verified when the transaction is successful and destination, amount and asset match.
steps: Create a record with a real payment hash and matching recipient wallet, amount, asset and network
Verify it and inspect its status
Change one recorded field and verify again
Submit a missing hash and an invalid hash
expected: Only a successful full match is labelled Verified on-chain; differing fields are listed, unknown hashes are Not found, and blank hashes remain Unverified.

name: Public transparency filters, details, pagination and CSV export
covers: organization, asset, network, status and date filters
description: Verifies that the public ledger remains browsable without a wallet and filters/export reflect the same record set.
steps: Open Public Transparency without connecting a wallet
Filter by asset and date, then sort by amount/date
Open a record detail and follow its explorer link
Export the filtered rows and move between pages
expected: The page shows truthful summaries, all filters and sort controls work, record detail shows verification evidence, CSV contains only filtered rows, and empty/loading states are accessible.

name: My Activity streams payments and matches published aid records
description: Verifies live activity updates with a polling fallback and identifies payments that have a published aid record.
steps: Connect a funded Testnet wallet
Open My Activity and inspect the stream indicator and XLM balance
Filter by type and date
Simulate stream disconnect and wait for fallback
expected: Activity uses the Horizon payment stream when available, falls back to polling, identifies matching published transaction hashes and remains usable on a 360px screen.

name: Server permissions, void history, admin roles and audit events
covers: server authorization on every protected route
description: Exercises the role matrix at the API boundary rather than relying on hidden UI controls.
steps: Use a donor wallet to attempt organization/admin mutations
Use an organization wallet to create, edit and void its own record and attempt editing another organization's record
Use a beneficiary wallet to open its recipient view
Use an admin wallet to add/remove a role and filter the audit log
Use logout everywhere and attempt a protected request
expected: Forbidden roles receive 403, organizations can only edit/void their own records, voided records remain visible with a reason, beneficiary results are wallet-scoped, admin changes and record creation are audited, CSRF and expired sessions block writes, and logout everywhere revokes active sessions.
